about_the_game:
COMING SOON!
Demo and Playtesting TBA

Our computers are the perfect habitat for these neat little bugs!

They're usually invisible, but with out proprietary console you can discover what's living in your personal computer!

Drag around the console on your desktop to see where they're hiding! Unlock more features of this device as you find more data and interact with your specific kinds of bugs.

Nearly infinite variety of what kinds of bugs your computer will generate.

Not all computer bugs cause problems. These tiny critters just want to make you day a little better!
